status: Post hoc control specified before geometry features or outcomes were examined
prior_knowledge: Neural-network source-test metrics, error overlaps and score diagnostics already known; this is not preregistered or confirmatory
question: Can source image width and height predict the binary source label without radiographic pixel features?
model: StandardScaler then L2 logistic regression, C=1, lbfgs, max_iter=1000, class_weight=None
identity: Verify all 5371 retained decoded image hashes; retain frozen training and test cohort digests
evaluation: Report all four partitions, confusion counts and descriptive AUROC, AP, Brier; no confirmatory comparisons
interpretation: Dimension predictability does not prove the neural networks use those shortcuts

uncertainty_and_export_check_extension.prior_knowledge: Geometry job live at 4000-image identity milestone; no geometry performance output observed
uncertainty_and_export_check_extension.reconstruction: Reconstruct all saved geometry scores from exported log-dimension standardization and logistic coefficients; require max absolute error <=1e-12 and zero changed classifications
uncertainty_and_export_check_extension.comparison: Compare fixed geometry control against frozen 320-pixel selected ensemble on hash-aligned test images
uncertainty_and_export_check_extension.uncertainty: 1000 seed-42 filename-group bootstrap replicates; percentile intervals for geometry metrics and paired geometry-minus-neural differences
uncertainty_and_export_check_extension.limitations: Post hoc source-test uncertainty conditional on fitted models; no training or model-selection uncertainty, clinical or external validation
